probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Trendspotter Tools Categories Lists Blog Submit a tool Overview Buy Trendspotter Tools Categories Lists Blog Submit a tool Overview Buy Trendspotter A directory you can trust is a directory that says no Trendspotter started in 2024 as a shared note between three people who were tired of AI lists written by the tools themselves. It is still small, and it still turns down most of what it tries. How a tool gets in, the same four steps for every tool, sponsored or not. Step 1 of 4 We find it From makers who submit, from readers, and from our own work. Nothing is added because it trended for a day. Step 2 of 4 We use it for a month On real projects with real deadlines, on the free plan first, then on the plan most people would pay for. Step 3 of 4 We write the review What it does well, where it falls short and who should skip it. Makers see the review when you do. Step 4 of 4 We check back Every review is revisited every six months. Tools that stop earning their place come off the shelf. What keeps us honest Rankings are not for sale.
